name: TV/TVC Runtime Boundary Observation
purpose: Observe or derive an existing TV/TVC-authorized provider-operation runtime from qualifying real provider-operation receipt chains, using the existing non-secret synthetic observer only as a diagnostic fallback, while preserving separate Interlock/InTr admission and Master Records custody boundaries without creating runtime, transition, credential, or custody authority.
trigger: a canonical task requires TVC runtime/broker evidence and a qualifying real provider-operation receipt chain exists or diagnostic route posture must be checked
scope: one manifest-bound TVC runtime evidence trajectory using existing provider-operation receipts first and synthetic observation only when needed for diagnostics
reuse_instructions: Use scripts/reconcile_tvc_runtime_boundary_reusable.py as the local orchestration-only primary runner. Qualifying real provider-operation receipts remain the preferred READY evidence. When they are absent, the diagnostic fallback invokes the already-local scripts/run_tvc_runtime_boundary_reusable.py wrapper, which reuses the released TVC same-service activation-delivery installer and then the non-secret TVC observer without fetching source or exporting protected values. The provider-operation worker may retain canonical Universal InTr request/response transport receipts using RTC-INTERLOCK-INTR-TRANSPORT-008 with exact source StegVerse-org/StegVerse-SDK and destination TVC:ProviderOperationBroker, but transport receipts are not an Interlock admission decision. The reusable runner emits standardized pre-admission evidence only when the same real transaction proves current WorkerCoordinator claim/fence evidence, ALLOW_OPERATION_RESULT, exact use_receipt, complete canonical InTr transport chains, no secret export, and authority ceilings. scripts/trigger_reusable_task.py must stop before Master Records when an explicit Interlock admission receipt required by post_runner_lifecycle_predicates is absent. Synthetic observer evidence remains diagnostic only and cannot satisfy AUTHENTIC_TVC_MIR_PROVIDER_SESSION_OBSERVED.
